briefs.name: Swap intent board
briefs.oldWorldReference: Uniswap routing UX and CoW-style intent matching
briefs.userJob: Let users express desired swaps before a native AMM or shared-state settlement system exists.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Accepted payloads can make intents visible quickly while settlement stays explicit.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Accepted swap-intent payload registry with no custody.
briefs.next: Build after auction/intent settlement drafts so bid/refund mechanics are clearer.

briefs.name: AMM pool research
briefs.userJob: Provide continuous swap liquidity between assets.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Fast PoW confirmation could improve user feedback once native asset and settlement rails exist.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Risk and UX brief for pool reserves, LP shares, price impact, and slippage.
briefs.next: Keep as research until asset, settlement, and composition assumptions are explicit.

briefs.name: Lending risk dashboard
briefs.userJob: Show collateral, borrow capacity, health, and liquidation risk before automated lending exists.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Accepted transaction receipts can audit deposits and repayments before richer covenant/vProg settlement.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Manual position/risk calculator fed by accepted receipts and external prices.
briefs.next: Build as a non-custodial simulator before any lending market claim.

briefs.name: Stable-value unit research
briefs.userJob: Hold or settle in a less volatile unit while using Kaspa payment rails.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Fast settlement would matter for commerce if stable-value issuance and redemption are credible.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Comparison brief: issuer-backed, overcollateralized, synthetic, and external stablecoin paths.
briefs.next: Keep as research and do not imply a native stablecoin exists.

briefs.name: Prediction hedge simulator
briefs.oldWorldReference: Augur, Gnosis Conditional Tokens, and portfolio hedge dashboards
briefs.userJob: Use event probabilities to think about portfolio exposure and hedges.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Signed attestations and accepted payload receipts can create an auditable signal history.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Simulation-only market board linked to attestation signals and manual portfolio positions.
briefs.next: Build only as a simulator with explicit no-trading/no-advice labels.

briefs.name: Insurance and protection pools
briefs.oldWorldReference: Nexus Mutual-style coverage and parametric insurance
briefs.userJob: Pool risk and pay claims when defined events occur.
briefs.kaspaEdge: RTD-style attestations could eventually help event evidence, but this repo only has research signals.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Parametric payout research note using simulated attestations.
briefs.next: Keep in backlog until oracle and capital pool assumptions are concrete.

briefs.name: Derivatives and options
briefs.userJob: Hedge price movement or express leveraged exposure.
briefs.kaspaEdge: UTXO-style conditional payout patterns may fit simple event contracts later.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: DLC-style conditional payout design note with no real funds.
briefs.next: Research only until oracle and margin paths are available.

briefs.name: Portfolio automation
briefs.oldWorldReference: Yearn, vault strategies, and portfolio rebalancers
briefs.userJob: Rebalance or hedge positions according to rules.
briefs.kaspaEdge: Fast accepted receipts can make manual or agent-assisted actions auditable.
briefs.firstSafeArtifact: Manual checklist and simulation planner for suggested actions.
briefs.next: Keep automation disabled; show suggested actions and exact transaction review only.

rules: Do not market AMMs, lending, stable-value products, derivatives, or insurance as live Kaspa apps from this backlog.
Start with risk dashboards, simulations, payload receipts, and intent registries before settlement claims.
Any real-money DeFi lane needs oracle, liquidity, liquidation, wallet, indexer, and security review plans.
Prediction and hedge workflows must stay advice-safe and simulation-first until settlement and resolution rails exist.
